stories.title: The mad scramble to find California's next governor becomes clearer today
stories.summary: It's been a chaotic scramble to find the new leader of California. After former Vice President Kamala Harris decided not to run, there hasn't been a clear candidate to pick up from Gov. Gavin Newsom.

stories.title: Heat, bugs, germs: U.S. public health prepares for the World Cup
stories.summary: For months ahead of the World Cup, states and cities have been preparing to protect travelers and local communities from potential threats including foodborne illness and infectious diseases.

stories.title: The ancient plant of rivercane makes a comeback for flood control
stories.summary: To prevent flooding, people in Western North Carolina are turning to a traditional basket weaving ingredient.

stories.title: Trump administration puts out strict Medicaid work rules
stories.summary: Work rules for sick people on Medicaid will be stricter than advocates had hoped. The Trump administration released its guidance for states, which have to stand up the new bureaucracies by Jan. 1.

stories.title: Rubio testifies on Capitol Hill about Cuba
stories.summary: Secretary of State Marco Rubio told the Senate Foreign Relations Committee that Cuba needs systemic reforms. But the administration is talking to Cuban officials like ex-leader Raul Castro's grandson.

stories.title: Author Ann Patchett's new novel makes space for optimism
stories.summary: NPR's Mary Louise Kelly speaks with bestselling author Ann Patchett about her new novel Whistler.
